info.description: Persistent shared memory infrastructure for AI agents. Stores memories + behavioral rules + credentials in PostgreSQL. REST API over HTTP; MCP tools are served via stdio client proxy only (server-side MCP HTTP transports removed in v5). Note: the host below is the default for local development; set ENGRAM_LISTEN_ADDR to change the listen address in production.

get.description: Without view, returns the unchanged full canonical catalog and unresolved metadata. Only view=retained_records selects bounded historical discovery: attribution_scope=unresolved_history and kind are required, q is trimmed literal UTF-8 (1024 bytes), limit defaults to 50 (1..200). That mode returns retainedRecordResponse, not projectListResponse. Its authenticated cursor binds the effective caller and normalized query; empty/short pages with a cursor are intermediate search WORK, not exhaustion. No total, has_more, canonical owner or snapshot is promised. All retained responses/errors are private,no-store. Memory privacy remains enforced; documents/issues retain ordinary authenticated route plus exact membership authority, not a new per-row ACL.
get.summary: List projects or retained historical records

get.description: Validates the complete selected reference/kind group, then reads its visible historical native payloads. Optional positive id selects only that exact member; without id the old whole-group behavior remains. Optional attribution_scope accepts only unresolved_history; omitted scope has the same historical meaning. Responses and record projections identify unresolved_history and omit project_key. A stale group is refused, never repaired through another group. Memory privacy remains enforced; documents/issues have ordinary authenticated route and exact-membership authority. private,no-store on success and errors.

get.description: Requires the exact issued reference/kind/positive id and complete current group validation. Optional attribution_scope accepts only unresolved_history; old omitted scope keeps that meaning. Document history preserves validated group IDs plus the selected path and historical project, including other versions, never one-ID truncation. Memory history keeps visibility and manage checks. Historical projections omit project_key. Stale/foreign selections are refused without reassociation. private,no-store on success and errors.
